title: Amaranthium (Boom)
description:
A mod for my pal. has a 'few' references.
The Nineth Installment in the Amaranthium Series.
body:
this mod has several referenes to other games, and Animation vs. Minecraft (King's Story Arc)
It also has an armour set and two weapons for my friend, as I wanted to make him a mod.
the following list is a list of referenced games.
1. Changed & Changed - Special by DragonSnow.
2. Super Mario Bros. Series by Nintendo.
that's really it.
   it does add Buzzy Beetle Shell Cannons, which you could use to play Mario Kart in Minecarts.

there are 5 mobs that represent Latex Beasts form "Changed" & "Changed - Special" added, and adds Galoombas from "Super Mario World" in Raids.

Oh, and, Sandstorm...

This mod is made to give the same feel as the rest of the "Amaranthium" series.


Anyone who wants to make an addon for this mod can if they wish.

Please Enjoy, You should probably use this with the rest of the "Amaranthium" Mods, and JEI is helpful as always.
:)
